children.title: EL Araby July 2026 Installment Campaign
children.summary: The EL Araby July 2026 Installment Campaign is an active campaign that applies to merchant ALAraby. It offers eligible card segments all_bm_credit_cards with 0% interest rate and no admin fees. The campaign allows for installments of either 12 or 18 months, with minimum transaction amounts of EGP 2000 for 12 months and EGP 2500 for 18 months.
